datasetName: Southern Utah Residential Build Cost Benchmark
sourceQualityNote: Local values are preliminary builder budgets and subcontractor allowances, not completed actual costs. Use them as comparable evidence rather than guaranteed prices.

projects.name: Silver Leaf
notes: The source budget covers one building containing two homes.
All building-level costs were divided by two before per-home comparison.
Retain the full-building and per-home values separately.

projects.name: Lot 39
notes: Cover sheet controls at 3,098 SF; floor sheets total approximately 3,101 SF.

projects.name: Lot 41
notes: One-story plan with standard and RV garage.

projects.name: Lot 49
notes: Cover sheet states 2,571 SF; another floor-plan sheet states 2,527 SF.

nationalBenchmark.sourceName: NAHB Cost of Constructing a Home — 2024
limitations: National average rather than Southern Utah-specific.
Construction cost excludes finished lot, financing, overhead/general expenses, marketing, sales commission and builder profit.

laborContext.sourceName: BLS Occupational Employment and Wages — St. George, May 2024
notes: Employee wage data are not contractor billable rates.
Do not apply this factor to installed lump sums without a documented labor share.
